{{Top}}
'''Durite''' was a shiny black material that was commonly used to construct [[Droid/Legends|droid]] shells. The ancient [[Malagarrian]]s used it to build [[mining droid]]s such as [[Q-7N]],<ref name="gatorw">''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]''</ref> and it was later used by the [[Imperial Department of Military Research/Legends|Imperial Department of Military Research]] to construct [[IT-O interrogation droid/Legends|IT-O Interrogator]] droids.<ref name="swvd">''[[Star Wars: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref>
